Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Downtown Zuzu Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] mod all 6 NPC (Buddy, Cal, David, Gwen, Kristoff, Sadie), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 


*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod ([b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726[/b])*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url][/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Downtown Zuzu mod (some where in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the "[b][NPC] Downtown Zuzu[/b]" folder from my Zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\Downtown-Zuzu-main[/b] folder to overwrite the "[b][NPC] Downtown Zuzu[/b]" folder in it.


Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Added another version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] mod.)



The character belongs to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/111722573]XxHarvzBackxX[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
